a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 almost certainly leaves both of us dead. The reserve holds only 4 cells, which is enough for one unit right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. If you have a better idea for getting both of us through, tell me and I'll consider it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round with you so the reserve can build back up for your unit. I won't take any more cells.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
